minutes.headline: Planning Board approved several site/stormwater permits and continued the 10 Parmenter Road subdivision pending review.
minutes.summary: The Planning Board closed hearings and approved permits for 222 West Townsend Road, 60 Crossroad, and a 149 Summer Street motor-vehicle sales site plan, each with standard conditions. It continued the larger nine-lot 10 Parmenter Road/Ruth Street stormwater and common-driveway application to June 8 pending peer review and fire-department sign-off, after a resident raised flooding concerns, and recommended the select board auction the Hollis Hill Road tax-title properties (old Lake Lodge).

what_happened.line: The board continued the nine-lot 10 Parmenter Road/Ruth Street stormwater and common-driveway application to June 8, pending peer review and fire-department sign-off on access.
The board closed hearings and approved stormwater and site-plan permits for 222 West Townsend Road, 60 Crossroad, and a motor-vehicle sales site at 149 Summer Street, each with standard conditions.
The board recommended the select board auction the Hollis Hill Road tax-title properties, including the former Lake Lodge, rather than have the town fund redevelopment.
A lakefront resident asked that flooding concerns from clear-cutting at the 10 Parmenter Road site be passed to the project's review engineer before it returns.

why_it_matters: The 10 Parmenter Road continuance affects a nine-lot subdivision's stormwater and driveway plans, with a neighbor's flooding concerns still to be addressed before any vote to approve.
Recommending auction of the Hollis Hill Road parcels would move two town-held properties toward private sale instead of municipal use, unless another board steps forward with funding first.
The approved permits at three sites clear conditions for construction to proceed there this year.
watch_next: June 8, 2026 Planning Board meeting: 10 Parmenter Road, 860 New West Townsend Road, and 30 Summer Street are all continued to that date.
